policy.selectionRule: LV1 and LV2 audience priority, high-risk S1 interaction or habitat similarity, then a high oblique separated sauropod interaction, an intentional vertical blade-horn color-texture study, and an eye-level rear three-quarter ornithomimosaur look-back
policy.diversityGate: A replacement must change camera family, direction, subject scale, action, spatial layout, or habitat; palette-only and mirror-only changes do not count.
policy.anatomyGate: Manual original-size anatomy review is required before pass, promotion, public asset copy, or app integration; the basic S1 representative side/full-body image remains protected.
